sources.title: SmartGames designed by Raf Peeters
sources.snippet: If you want more information on how I work and what inspires me, this is the right place to be. I made this website, not because I think I am that interesting, but to answer the number one question that people keep on asking: how do you do it? At the same time this site functions as a kind of logbook for myself, so I can remember why I made specific design choices. All the logic puzzles below are being marketed by Smart Toys & Games, a Belgian toy company, specialized in educational toys and games. PDF’s of the booklets with challenges and solutions of specific SmartGames can now be downloaded there. Update - new SmartGames 2026: Last year I designed again (too) many IQ puzzles. In 2026 that game will exclusively  be available in the UK (The Happy Puzzle Company). So for most of the world, this is a novelty as well, and my favorite one.
